AI-generated local Kokoro am_michael; selected by user; Apache-2.0 model. Script: Your crew is safe in orbit. Let’s prepare our reply.
AI-generated local Kokoro am_michael; selected by user; Apache-2.0 model. Script: Pause the other station to free its power.
AI-generated local Kokoro am_michael; selected by user; Apache-2.0 model. Script: Leaves use light, water and carbon dioxide to make sugars for growth.

AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A fault separated your safety capsule from the crew’s ship.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Your crew is still in orbit. Your capsule landed at the old base.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Emergency air and heat are on. The radio is off. Find a way to reach your crew.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A little help can make a big difference.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: That’s right! You can use that idea on your next mission.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Try again. Look at the picture, or hear the question once more.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: You grew and picked a crop for the crew.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Plants need suitable light, water, nutrients, temperature and air. Our two switches represent only part of that environment.

AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: CSA lists about 21–28 days for leaf lettuce and 45–65 days for soybeans. Our planner used the upper end of each range. Real growing conditions can change the result.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: The example soybeans need boiling. Lettuce can be eaten without cooking. Crops add different nutrients to meals, alongside stored food.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A new crop needs cooking. What should the crew include in its plan? A way to prepare the harvest, or Only the planting date?
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Your report keeps the measurements and the unanswered questions together.

AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: RAD aboard Curiosity measured radiation on Mars. Our archive shows 84 absorbed dose rate readings, in micrograys per hour, from 1 January 2015.

AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: In a separate 2016 study at Butte M12, surrounding terrain blocked part of the sky. Researchers found a 4% decrease in expected dose rate there.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A missing value means that measurement is unavailable. A reading at one place does not tell us whether another site is safe.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: The new site has no radiation reading. What belongs in your report? A measurement is still needed, or The missing reading is zero?
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: You used stored energy to prepare water for the crew.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. Some spacecraft use sunlight to run their equipment.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A battery stores energy. Spacecraft can use that stored energy when sunlight is unavailable.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: An electric motor transfers energy into motion. In our base, the pump uses part of the battery reserve.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: When the solar panels are in shadow, what can provide stored energy? The battery, or An empty cable?
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Your plan got water ready and a message to the crew.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: On Hubble, electricity powers instruments, computers, heaters and transmitters.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Running more devices at once asks for more power. In our base, the pump and radio together exceed the supply limit.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Pausing one job made room for the next. The battery reserve showed how much stored energy remained.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: If two jobs exceed the supply limit, what could you try? Run them one after the other, or Switch both on again?
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: We can reach your crew. First, find the power console with me.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: This was a research base. My team left recordings to help explorers like you.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Look through the window. This is a real picture of Mars.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Let’s read a real rover record. Then tell the crew what the evidence shows.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Our base is awake. Next time, we’ll step outside and explore Mars together. This is the end of our demo.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: First, connect both radio plugs at the power console.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Tune the antenna until the two signals line up.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: The crew can hear us. Send the ready signal.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Open the rover archive. Look for a missing reading.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: A dash is not zero. What should we tell the crew?
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Repair the relay so the crew can receive your notes.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: The crew heard you. The garden is growing. Next time, we step outside.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Your journey log remembers the things you did.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: Choose where to go next, or replay the story.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: You reached the credits. Thank you for exploring Mars with us.

AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: This is a playable demo. The base is imagined, but the rover readings come from Mars.
AI-generated locally: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 / am_michael. Script: The crew needs a radio relay and a rover report. Which job will you start with?
